dct_description_sm: This point data layer represents the 187 polling places in the City of Milwaukee, Wisconsin as of September 17, 2026. Attributes include polling-place name and address and information about entrances, accessibility, and parking. The source portal states that the dataset is refreshed nightly. The source shapefile is projected in NAD27 / Wisconsin South (EPSG:32054).
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
